svg.title: VV Schiehaven
svg.desc: VV Schiehaven (NL-5), Rotterdam, Netherlands — Football Architect. Heraldic football crest featuring the Erasmus Bridge, Rotterdam skyline, anchor and river wave. Approved colors: #173B5E, #AFCFE1 and #FFFFFF. Shield and geometric ornaments are symmetric; the bridge and skyline are intentionally asymmetric. Centered at 90 percent canvas height.
